hook_text: He painted the most famous portrait in the world and designed a flying machine more than five hundred years ago. Who was he?
clip_script: Rustenburg, a page of strange backwards writing. Hold it up to a mirror and it can be read. It belongs to Leonardo da Vinci, born in Italy in 1452. He was a painter: the Mona Lisa and The Last Supper. He was an inventor: flying machines, a parachute, a diving suit. He was a scientist: he studied the human body, birds, water and rocks. He filled thousands of notebook pages. A true Renaissance person: curious about everything.
visual_style: Whiteboard notebook page flipping in a mirror, then sketches of a flying machine, a parachute and a human heart drawing themselves.
mood: Fascinated and playful, like opening a genius's sketchbook.
pacing: Mirror trick first, then one quick sketch per talent, ending on his curiosity.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and try writing your name in mirror writing.
